title: World Forum created by Mikhail Gorbachev, 1995-2000

tellings.quote: It's um it was created by McKill go Gorbachoff back in the 90s in 95 to 2000. It was a 5-year event that ended up in New York City when they dropped the ball.

plain: In the 1990s Mikhail Gorbachev set up a World Forum, a five-year event that ran from 1995 to 2000 and ended in New York City when the ball dropped on New Year's Eve. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had repeated UFO encounters, tells Michels this as something he was told. He gives no more detail about what the forum did.
